entities.summary: Slim Borgudd (b. 1946-11-25, Borgholm) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Borgholm and Sweden. Known in the fields of sweden, composers & musicians, europe.
